apply_fp8_block_quantization: apply FP8-Block quantization to the Kimi K2 model using model_free_ptq from llmcompressor
configure_model_free_ptq_scheme: configure model_free_ptq with FP8_BLOCK scheme and layer ignore patterns for selective quantization
specify_quantization_ignore_layers: specify layer patterns to ignore during model_free_ptq quantization including gate and lm_head layers
set_quantization_device_and_workers: set CUDA device and max_workers for parallel model_free_ptq quantization execution
save_quantized_model_directory: save the quantized model using compressed-tensors format to a named output directory
